tracks.title: Nebuú
tracks.about: Nebuú was originally titled “The Story of King Nebuú.” The track tells the life story of a fictional character who lives in my imagination. I later reshaped the ending into a more pop influenced experience, giving listeners a familiar and relatable way back from his world.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal

tracks.scene: Trembling waves symbolize the uncertainty of life before gradually transforming into a warmer, more familiar world. A person emerges from isolation and learns to connect with others through love.

tracks.title: Crystal
tracks.about: Crystal is a song about living in the clouds and looking down at the world. It expresses the superego, an observing perspective that sees life from above. The song is meant to capture the feeling of stepping outside yourself and viewing everything from a distance.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.scene: A figure sits quietly among luminous clouds, looking out across a dreamlike sky washed in pink, violet, and gold. Suspended above the world, the figure observes from a distance, surrounded by softness, light, and peaceful introspection. A geometric window floats in the distance, suggesting another world or perspective.

tracks.title: Green Tea
tracks.about: Green Tea is a fight for survival. It begins with heaviness, settles into calm in the middle, and reaches a powerful resolution that feels less like an ending and more like a continuation. This is a story that rewards patient listening and allows its narrative to unfold over time.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense
tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Electronic / experimental
tracks.scene: A woman finds herself trapped in a game where every choice carries a cost. Surrounded by temptation, greed, and uncertainty, she must decide what she is willing to protect and what she might sacrifice to survive. As the world around her becomes increasingly chaotic, survival begins to feel like a game.

tracks.title: Aurelillo
tracks.about: Aurelillo is meant to be a deeply relaxing trance piece that serves as the album’s outro. After the chaos of Green Tea, it brings the listener into a place of calm, closing this album while gently leading into the next.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.scene: The sensation of floating weightlessly through a soft, open space as a gentle tingling spreads through the body. Colors and light slowly shift, signaling completion and carrying the moment from one chapter into the next.

tracks.title: que Soñaba en el piano
tracks.about: I wrote this song while sitting at the piano after receiving unexpected criticism from someone close to me about a musical collaboration. I was trying to process the response and the doubt it created. Was my judgment that far off? Could I no longer distinguish between something good and something sloppy? Was I becoming sloppy myself? The experience deeply unsettled me, and the song emerged from that confusion.
tracks.mood: Cinematic, Dreamlike, Reflective, Peaceful
tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Singer songwriter
tracks.scene: A quiet room after a difficult conversation. The piano remains still while the same words replay in the mind, creating a pause filled with questions. Nothing outwardly changes, but the familiar space feels different as confidence quietly gives way to uncertainty.
tracks.lyrics:
Anoche, que soñaba en el piano. 
Asimilaba tu respuesta 
Que fue así, que fue verdad 
Anoche, que soñaba en el piano

tracks.title: David Jones Snow
tracks.about: You want a tense song? David Jones Snow is your song. It answers the doubts raised by the previous track. Forget all of that. This is my world, and I create the sounds I want. I am willing to be vulnerable and share their chaos because they express something real to me. It is the feeling of saying, “Oh yes. No one is stopping me. Here we go again.”
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Tense, Nightmare
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
tracks.scene: A boat pushes forward through towering waves, carried by a melody that refuses to stop. The wind and water scrape against the skin, leaving scars from the journey, yet the boat continues through the storm regardless.

tracks.title: Dream 2
tracks.about: This song builds on the foundation of another song that is dear to me, using its powerful synths to create something energetic and fun. My sister felt inspired by the music and sent me a set of English lyrics. I selected the lines that fit the song, edited them, and incorporated some of them into the final version. I sing them with a strong accent, since Spanish is my first language, and I embrace that playfulness throughout the track. At one point, I even say, “I don’t even know what I said, for real.”
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Tense, Dynamic
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Singer songwriter
tracks.scene: A woman sits motionless in the center of a room while everything around her continues to move. She feels defeated, and even as she travels from place to place, the same pain follows and weighs on her. Life begins to feel like sleepwalking through a dream until she can no longer tell whether she is awake, asleep, or simply going through the motions. Exhausted, she wants only to return to sleep and dream again.

tracks.title: Tortilla Song
tracks.about: Tortilla Song is a funny song to me. It is tense and loud, yet it makes a quiet statement. It may seem like I do not know what I am doing, but I actually have a clear direction. It is playful, energetic, and filled with the sound of trumpets.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Tense
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Electronic / experimental
tracks.scene: A tortilla cooks on a hot comal as dark spots slowly appear across its surface. Each mark forms where the heat is most intense, yet those toasted spots are what make the tortilla look familiar and complete. What might initially seem imperfect becomes a sign that it is ready, authentic, and exactly as it should be.

tracks.title: Wait for me UNO
tracks.about: In music, counting is very important, especially finding your way back to the first beat so everything stays consistent. I sometimes struggle with that, so this song represents my constant chase of the one. That is why it is called “Wait for Me, Uno.” I am calling out, “Wait for me! Uno, wait!” The song turns that musical chase into its own story.

tracks.title: Dar
tracks.about: Dar is a song I created around the B major and B minor scales. Moving between them creates captivating melodic lines and a sense of emotional tension. The song represents giving yourself fully to a mission.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful

tracks.scene: The scene captures the Annunciation at the moment the Angel Gabriel reveals the Virgin Mary’s mission. Fear comes first, followed by humility, wonder, and a growing sense of hope. She feels overwhelmed that she has been chosen, yet she recognizes her strength and accepts what lies ahead. Her emotions move through the uncertainty of “Yes. Yes! Yes? Wait... I said yes, YES.” holding emotions at the same time.
tracks.additional_credits: Special thanks to Brenda Fitz, whose teaching and feedback inspired the experience behind this track.

tracks.title: romA
tracks.about: romA is written backward, which is why the capital letter appears at the end. When reversed, it becomes Amor, the Spanish word for love. The track captures a moment created with love, with birds chirping live, life unfolding in the background, and my piano flowing alongside it. I love you.

tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
tracks.scene: A room with large windows overlooking trees and palm trees, with birds flying across a blue Nevada sky filled with cinematic clouds. A piano sits near the window while cars pass below, a bus stops, and everyday life continues. The scene feels open and alive, as though the song itself is breathing with the world outside.

tracks.title: OOO2
tracks.about: I spent an entire day writing OOO2, completely dedicated to it. There was no food and no distractions, only the song and its flow. Inspired by the sinking boat scene in Life of Pi, the track feels both tense and weightless. You move through it as if struggling against a persistent droning current.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
tracks.scene: A ship moves through the night toward an unfamiliar destination. Inside a small cabin, anticipation is mixed with unease. Then the vessel begins to sink. Panic spreads through the corridors as alarms and Morse code distress signals cut through the darkness. Everything tilts, shifts, and falls. The deep blue ocean becomes now this black liquid before your eyes, demanding your body, your blood, and your soul as the struggle against drowning takes over.

tracks.about: Anoche is a reinterpretation of “Que Soñaba en el Piano” from the album SDLC_02. It combines different genres, styles, and harmonies, all moving toward one goal: making the song fun to listen to.

tracks.scene: A vast, quiet room filled with soft light. A woman kneels in the center, facing the Tabernacle, while another version of herself speaks to her and tries to pull her away. She remains still and focused. The scene then shifts into ordinary daily life, where she sits at her piano as news, conversations, and human experiences continue to reach her. She takes everything in and tries to understand it, firmly repeating, “No, no,” because nothing will separate her from Him.

tracks.title: The Rebellion
tracks.about: The Rebellion moves through two competing flows, with the piano and drums constantly colliding to create a restless, confrontational sound. It carries anger toward the injustices found in human relationships and everyday life. It is the feeling of being unable to leave while becoming increasingly frustrated with staying.

tracks.scene: Two opposing currents move through the same confined space, one fluid and deliberate, the other sharp and relentless. They collide again and again, but neither can escape or overpower the other. The space fills with tension as every impact reflects the frustration of being forced to remain inside a system

tracks.title: John 3:16
tracks.about: I attended Mass, where John 3:16 was part of the Gospel reading. I felt inspired to create a melody that could accompany the passage, giving the listener space to read, pray, and reflect.

tracks.title: Sandais
tracks.about: This was an unexpected recording. I simply started playing, and the piece evolved while I was lucky enough to be recording. It became a beautiful transitional song filled with unexpected changes. It feels playful, constant, intriguing, and completely centered on the piano.

tracks.scene: A quiet space suspended in anticipation, filled with the feeling that something is about to happen. A steady pulse moves beneath the silence, creating tension that continues to build. Suddenly, the space opens into a rush of color, movement, and emotion, releasing everything that had been waiting underneath.

tracks.title: Lo que vibra en la vida
tracks.about: I created this song using a scale of Neapolitan Dorian (Spanish origin) to honor the stories of my grandfather and great grandfather. It reflects their struggles and the honorable choices they made, which helped make the life I live today possible.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter
tracks.scene: At dawn, a shipwrecked man reaches the shore of an unfamiliar land. Exhausted and carrying almost nothing, he looks back at the ocean and understands that everything he once knew has been left behind. He gathers the courage to walk toward a new life. As the unfamiliar town begins to wake, he finds work and accepts every sacrifice placed before him. His labor allows his siblings to study and build futures of their own. While they open books and enter classrooms, he continues working quietly, finding dignity and purpose in giving them the opportunities he had to leave behind.

tracks.title: I hate to love you
tracks.about: This track explores a relationship of love and hate with something you feel compelled to do. You love the process, even though the task leaves scars. You know the struggle is necessary because it will help you grow, so you continue. In the end, you hate how much you love it.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense
tracks.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental
tracks.scene: A small classroom with only a musician and a teacher. The musician presents work that has never been shared this openly before. The teacher listens closely and offers a direct critique. The moment feels vulnerable and uncomfortable, but it is also necessary. The choice becomes clear. Accept the discomfort, learn from it, and continue moving forward without stopping.
tracks.additional_credits: Special thanks to Ms. Lindsey Live, whose teaching and feedback inspired the experience behind this track.

tracks.title: Don Perro
tracks.about: My teacher challenged me to create a song with a more “solid beat”. For some reason, my brain interpreted that as, “Do they want me to make something predictable, like reggaeton? Ugh.” So I did. I created a reggaeton song in my own style. It is Susi’s one and only reggaeton song, built around a single lyric: “What are you gonna do, Mr. Dog?” Irreverent and playful.
tracks.mood: Cinematic, Playful, energetic, irreverent, humorous, bold, rhythmic.
tracks.genre: Contemporary instrumental, Electronic / experimental, Reggaeton, Latin, experimental.
tracks.scene: A lively Spanish bar filled with small wooden tables, shared plates, cold drinks, bright lights, and overlapping conversations. Friends move between tables, laughing loudly and saying whatever comes to mind. The scene feels familiar yet rebellious, as if everyone belongs while refusing to behave like everyone else. It is playful, unapologetic, and completely comfortable with its own absurdity.
tracks.additional_credits: Special thanks to Brenda Fitz, whose teaching and feedback inspired the experience behind this track.

tracks.title: Disdain
tracks.about: Disdain is about an ugly feeling that surfaced one day when I experienced genuine envy toward someone. I examined the emotion and realized how much it felt like poison spreading through my heart and entire body. I wrote the song from the perspective of rejecting that feeling, addressing it directly and declaring that I never want to experience it again.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense
tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
tracks.scene: An employee has spent years arriving early, staying late, and becoming highly capable at the work. A new person joins the company and immediately receives the same salary without having the same experience or abilities. Resentment begins to grow as the employee watches the unfairness unfold. Then comes the realization that envy is causing more harm than the situation itself. Disgusted by the feeling, the employee chooses to release it and return attention to their own path before the bitterness takes control.

tracks.title: Te Quiero
tracks.about: Te Quiero is a song I wrote after being ill for some time in a foreign country. It is about moving through a tunnel and finally seeing a distant light. Even the smallest glimpse brings hope, along with the realization that the only way to reach it is by learning true self love.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter
tracks.scene: A winged figure sits inside a dark cave, her wings three times the size of her body. Mud covers the feathers, hiding their natural pearl white color. Deep within the cave, she discovers an old grand piano. She does not know what it is or how to use it, but she sits down and gently places one finger on a key. A sweet sound fills the cave and immediately captures her. She begins pressing more keys, discovering endless combinations of notes capable of expressing every part of her life. The melodies are not created so she will be remembered. They are necessary for her survival. Everything she has carried inside can finally leave her through the music. The sounds feel as though they must be released and shared rather than kept within her.

tracks.title: ...25 (Bonus Track)
tracks.about: This is a traditional Catholic Christmas carol from Spain, I believe. My husband Francisco and I were in DrummerLab’s practice studio. As he played, I began singing the carol and suddenly decided to record it and add harmonies. I consider it a bonus track because it preserves the feeling of a rehearsal. At the end, I intentionally left in a conversation about editing the song and its pitch. I chose not to clean it up because that unpolished moment became part of the song’s character.
tracks.mood: Atmospheric, Dreamlike, Warm, Peaceful
tracks.genre: New Age / meditative, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental
tracks.scene: A group of family and friends gathers on a quiet street in Spain on a cold Christmas night. They are wrapped in winter coats, scarves, hats, and gloves as their breath becomes visible in the air. Warm streetlights illuminate the buildings and stone pavement while the group sings together, filling the night with voices, laughter, and the repeated sound of “fum, fum, fum.” Neighbors listen from nearby windows and doorways as the familiar carol brings warmth and community into the winter street.
